summary: @or-sdk/bots preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes 727 KB obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares a preinstall hook that runs setup.mjs. setup.mjs is itself javascript-obfuscator-style (renamed identifiers, per-function string dictionaries, indirect property access). It probes for a local `bun` binary and, if absent, downloads a Bun runtime archive from GitHub releases to a temp directory, extracts it, chmods the binary executable, and immediately invokes it via execFileSync against the sibling file math_init.js with the package directory as cwd. math_init.js is a single-line, 727,680-byte file with rotated string-array obfuscation (`_0xXXXX` identifiers, `WV8StW`/`hc1jfK9`-style decoder + array-rotation), and its name does not correspond to any functionality documented for the package (advertised as a Bots API SDK). The alternate-runtime-dropper pattern executes the payload under a freshly-fetched runtime that Node-based scanners do not inspect, and both the loader and the payload are obfuscated. Installing this package causes obfuscated code of unknown behavior to execute automatically on the installer's host before any application code runs.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
